overview: The Medford Community Preservation Committee heard presentation proposals for FY27 CPA funding from the Mystic River Watershed Association and the Medford Affordable Housing Trust. The committee also approved an emergency roof repair grant for the Unitarian Universalist Church and reallocated $50,000 in funding for Condon Shell field lighting improvements.

items.title: Mystic River West Medford Shoreline Revitalization Presentation
items.summary: Carl Alexander of the Mystic River Watershed Association presented a proposal to begin pre-permitting design for a 1.5-mile shoreline revitalization project in West Medford.

items.title: Medford Affordable Housing Trust FY27 Funding Request
items.summary: Katherine Buckingham presented an overview of the Medford Affordable Housing Trust's recent accomplishments and requested $600,000 in FY27 CPA annual tranche funding.

items.title: Unitarian Universalist Church Roof Repair Grant
items.summary: Approved a $10,000 emergency grant to repair a leaking flat roof at the Unitarian Universalist Church, conditioned on the church preparing a permanent restoration plan complying with historic standards.

items.title: Condon Shell Field Lighting Funding Reallocation
items.summary: Approved reducing the FY26 Tufts Park lighting grant by $50,000 and reallocating those funds to the Condon Shell lighting improvement project.

items.title: Thomas Brooks Park Archaeological Survey Update
items.summary: Ryan Hayward of the Historical Commission informed the committee that existing project funds would be reallocated to perform ground-penetrating radar scanning to locate historic house features at Thomas Brooks Park.
